objectives.text: Establish Cognirise as a trusted partner for the authority's responsible AI and service-operations agenda.
Create a qualified pipeline of decision-maker conversations around one priority service transformation.

draftStrategy.winHypothesis: Cognirise can win by combining responsible AI strategy with hands-on service-operations improvement, demonstrating a measurable pilot before expanding to the authority's wider transformation portfolio.
keyPlays: Map the authority's priority services, decision makers and procurement route before proposing a solution.
Offer an executive working session to align AI ambition, governance needs and a measurable pilot outcome.
Bring a workflow diagnostic and adoption plan to the pilot conversation rather than leading with technology.
Publish a concise, evidence-led point of view tailored to public-service delivery and responsible AI.

expectedOutput.rationale: The draft focuses the account on a credible land-and-expand motion: establish trust through responsible AI and service-operations expertise, then prove value through a measurable pilot. It avoids unsupported revenue or relationship claims and leaves room for partner validation.

notes: Strategy Developer fixture exercises the complete proposal shape with measurable objectives and a cautious confidence level.
